summary: The revision materially closes all seven prior Keeper gaps: the pre-code/activation gates are non-circular, a versioned state and persistence protocol exists, exact SourceRef lifecycle and exhaustive readiness semantics are defined, artifact schemas and donor migration are aligned, TASK-008 names donor reads and runnable evidence, and application-architecture/data-integrity capabilities are present. A fresh Agent still cannot responsibly start TASK-008, however, because the new canonical contracts contradict their own host/model field-ownership rule, omit the semantic owner of the 5-10 elicitation units required at wave open, make a required calibration source optional at the only commit event, do not define persistence for required generated-artifact provenance, exclude an allowed post-exit trial-reflection scope from the transition guard, and publish an L0 exact command that fails under Windows PowerShell 5.1 despite passing under PowerShell 7.

gaps.gap: The model-facing Interviewer contract still requires host-owned IDs. `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:288-303` types `InterviewerProposal.mission` as the full `WaveMission`, which requires `id` and `wave_id` at :172-184; its `questions` omit top-level question IDs but retain nested `QuestionOption.id` from :190-199. `.loom/design/adaptive-interview-system.md:146-160` separately defines an incompatible `WaveMissionProposal` containing `mission_id`. This contradicts `prompts/interviewer-v2.md:50-54` (the host assigns IDs) and `prompts/PROMPT-ARCHITECTURE.md:146-158` (model proposals never invent host IDs/timestamps/revisions).
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: TASK-008 must create the Zod schemas before prompt wiring. A fresh Agent must guess whether the model emits mission, wave and option IDs, whether trusted IDs are injected before validation, or whether the canonical proposal types should omit them; each choice changes validation, idempotency and later Prompt v3 compatibility.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Define one canonical `WaveMissionProposal` and nested `QuestionOptionProposal` that omit every host-owned ID, make `InterviewerProposal` use them, and align adaptive-interview-system, Prompt Architecture, interviewer prompt and lint. Add a schema test proving model output contains no newly invented host-owned ID while the committed object receives host IDs exactly once.

gaps.gap: No contract assigns semantic ownership for the 5-10 elicitation units that must exist when a wave mission commits. `.loom/design/state-and-persistence-protocol.md:139` requires `WAVE_MISSION_COMMITTED` to commit a wave whose mission owns 5-10 units, and `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:224-250` requires `Wave.elicitation_units`. But neither `InterviewerProposal` at `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:288-298` nor `WaveMissionProposal` at `.loom/design/adaptive-interview-system.md:146-160` proposes those units; an opening microbatch can supply only 1-3 question targets. The host/model split says semantic question targets belong to Interviewer, not a deterministic host heuristic.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: At the first `WAVE_MISSION_COMMITTED` transition, TASK-008 cannot construct the required Wave without either inventing 2-9 future decision targets in the host, weakening the transition invariant, or dynamically adding units through an event that does not exist.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Choose and document one executable lifecycle: either the open-wave proposal supplies 5-10 ID-free unit proposals that the host IDs and commits atomically, or units are added through explicitly named guarded events with a clear close invariant. Align the state table, event payloads, Interviewer schema/prompt and property tests.

gaps.gap: Calibration source ownership is contradictory. `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:367-374` requires every `Calibration` to contain `source_ref`, and the propagation rules treat calibration/correction as evidence. Yet `.loom/design/state-and-persistence-protocol.md:194` defines `CalibrationSubmitted` with `source?: SourceVersion`, while `CALIBRATION_SUBMITTED` is the only transition that can record the verdict and its source. No preceding event creates that calibration source.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: The TASK-008 transaction cannot deterministically satisfy the required `Calibration.source_ref` when `source` is absent, and a fresh implementer must guess whether verdict-only calibration is a source, whether only correction text creates one, or whether a separate write is allowed outside the event transaction.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Make the event payload and source lifecycle agree: require and atomically insert a calibration `SourceVersion` for every verdict, or make `source_ref` conditional with an explicit alternate provenance rule and event. Add verdict-without-text, correction, duplicate delivery and rollback tests.

gaps.gap: Required generated-artifact provenance has no persisted canonical shape. `prompts/PROMPT-ARCHITECTURE.md:112-123` and `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:669-677` require every generated artifact to store prompt contract revision/hash, schema hash, context-builder version, model/provider/config and fixture-suite version. `.loom/design/state-and-persistence-protocol.md:87-106` gives the ephemeral `ProposalEnvelope` only `prompt_hash`, `schema_hash`, `context_hash` and `model_config_hash`; it omits prompt contract revision, context-builder version, provider/model fields and fixture-suite version, and explicitly says proposals are not domain facts. The committed artifact types do not add a shared provenance record.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: TASK-008 owns persistence and artifact field ownership. The Agent must invent whether provenance is embedded per artifact, stored in a shared immutable generation record, copied from the proposal, or lost after TTL; this affects audits, activation and TASK-010 report reproducibility.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Define one persisted `GenerationProvenance`/generation-call record with every required field, its foreign-key relationship to each generated artifact, and the atomic copy from proposal to commit. Align ProposalEnvelope, event metadata/domain types and add a persistence/replay test.

gaps.gap: The transition table excludes one of the five canonical bounded-chat scopes after a trial is exited. `.loom/design/state-and-persistence-protocol.md:160` permits `BOUNDED_REFLECTION_OPENED` only for explain/compare/adjust/blueprint, omitting `reflect_on_trial`; `TRIAL_EXITED` returns to `parallel_lives_ready` at :164. But `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md:651-657`, `prompts/sensemaker-chat-v3.md:11-17,43-47`, and TASK-012 require `reflect_on_trial`, explicitly treating early stop as information.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A user who exits early reaches a state from which the canonical guard forbids opening the very reflection mode promised by the prompt and later task. Implementing either the table or the product contract causes a mismatch in XState guards and tests.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Add `reflect_on_trial` to the appropriate `BOUNDED_REFLECTION_OPENED` guard with an exited/completed trial prerequisite, or define a separate legal transition. Add a state test for exit -> reflection -> committed reflection source.

gaps.gap: The claimed dependency-free L0 gate is not reproducible with the documented exact command across the current Windows shell surface. `.loom/design/acceptance-and-research.md` declares `& .\.loom\tools\verify-harness.ps1` as the exact command and TASK-007 claims it passed. `rtk pwsh -NoProfile -File .loom/tools/verify-harness.ps1` prints `HARNESS_LINT_OK`, but `rtk powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .loom/tools/verify-harness.ps1` fails with a ParserError/misdecoded UTF-8 text around line 63 because the script is UTF-8 without a Windows PowerShell-compatible encoding marker.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh Agent following the stated exact PowerShell command can receive a parser failure instead of the required pre-code evidence. The document does not specify PowerShell 7 as a prerequisite or command, so the gate's truth depends on an unstated shell choice.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Either make the script encoding compatible with Windows PowerShell 5.1 and show the exact command prints `HARNESS_LINT_OK`, or change the canonical exact command/prerequisite to `pwsh` and verify it from a fresh shell. Record the exact passing output in TASK-007 evidence.

evidence: `rtk loom context --keeper` reported Keeper attempt 6, prepared digest `4b027c6e4bca4a00d6c0ae1bd9d3800d03f4b1b42d20f3e8da097fae74ed4b8d`, 27 confirmed facts, zero assumptions/questions, 11 design documents, 10 distinct capability dossiers and 13 tasks.
`rtk loom check` returned healthy; `rtk loom task status` returned 13 total / 7 open / 6 done; `rtk loom task next` still selected TASK-007 pending this Keeper result.

Prior gap 1 is materially closed by `.loom/PROJECT.md`, `.loom/design/acceptance-and-research.md`, `.loom/design/prompt-architecture-brief.md`, `prompts/PROMPT-ARCHITECTURE.md` and TASK-010: structural/contract fixtures precede code, while real-model evaluation and activation follow matching runtime work.

Prior gaps 2-4 are materially closed by `.loom/design/state-and-persistence-protocol.md` and `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md`: versioned envelopes/ledger/head, legal transitions and recovery, exact SourceRef/SourceVersion/SourceHead lifecycle, stale closure, and an exhaustive formal/provisional readiness function are all present.

Prior gaps 5-7 are materially closed by `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md` donor-v2 migration and canonical fields, the exact donor reads/commands in `rtk loom task get TASK-008`, and distinct `.loom/capabilities/application-architecture.md` plus `.loom/capabilities/data-integrity.md` dossiers.

Donor-code claims in `.loom/design/prompt-architecture-brief.md` were verified on disk: `app/api/wave/route.ts` has `MAX_WAVES=4`/`MAX_QUESTIONS=19` and host uncertainty selection; `lib/interview/templates.ts` says fixed Wave 1; runtime prompts remain inline; `lib/ai/sensemaker/wave.ts` uses placeholder evidence IDs; and `lib/ai/sensemaker/final.ts` contains `no-evidence` and fabricated fallback lives.

`rtk pwsh -NoProfile -File .loom/tools/verify-harness.ps1` passed with `HARNESS_LINT_OK` (`json=14 markdown=31 prompts=6 decisions=19`), while the Windows PowerShell invocation failed before execution with a parser error, demonstrating the unstated shell dependency.

`rtk rg` and direct UTF-8 reads of `.loom/design/insight-plan-contracts.md`, `.loom/design/state-and-persistence-protocol.md`, `.loom/design/adaptive-interview-system.md`, all Prompt v3 files, `.loom/design/prompt-eval-fixtures.md`, TASK-007 through TASK-013, and the relevant donor code produced the field- and transition-level contradictions listed above.
